description: Labelled page pairs over tests/fixtures/demo/research_site.jsonl, by canonical URL. Pairs are UNORDERED. Labels are editorial judgements written from the rubric below, not from any implementation's scores.

rubric.strong: Should be recommended as related: the same market in any geography; or a parent/child or declared (complementary, supply-chain) market relation within the same country or a containing region; or an insight on that market and geography.
rubric.weak: Plausibly related, not a first-choice recommendation: a declared relation across geographies, a sibling market or declared industry adjacency within one geography, or a real-world link the taxonomy does not declare.
rubric.unrelated: Different industries with no declared link. Hard negatives share a geography or surface wording (storage, cells, materials, infrastructure).

pool_rule: Retrieval candidates = every published, canonical, unprotected report or insight with at least 120 words (listed in 'pool'). The protected medical-devices report, drafts, the alias edition, thin pages, hubs and corporate pages are excluded.
